text: dsh-auto-review 是面向长时运行 DSH 会话的插件，在工具执行前检查写入、编辑、命令和读取请求，并在记录到改动后安排子代理审查。它提供可自定义的本地规则、会话级 Auto Mode 开关、自动或手动审查、审查结果消息，以及 Web 输入框状态徽标。用户可用 /review 手动发起审查，并用 /security 查看状态或调整会话开关。适合希望在 DSH 工作流中加入操作前检查和改动复核的用户；需要安装 DSH 插件，代码未声明额外 API key。

dsh-auto-review checks selected DSH tool actions and reviews tracked changes with a subagent. It offers configurable rules, a session toggle, automatic or manual reviews, result messages, and a Web status badge. Use /review to request review and /security to inspect or change session mode.
想在 DSH 工具执行前检查操作内容。
我希望改动完成后由另一个 agent 再看一遍。
给长时间运行的 DSH 会话加一个可切换的自动模式。
能不能手动触发当前会话改动的复核？
想查看审查规则数量和当前模式状态。
在 Web 输入框里显示自动审查是否启用。
希望自行添加或调整匹配规则。
I want DSH to check selected tool actions before they run.
dsh-auto-review 的功能「动作前规则检查」：它检查指定工具参数中的文本和路径；匹配时向用户询问是否仅放行本次操作，未获批准则阻止。
dsh-auto-review 的功能「改动后的子代理审查」：根 agent 的写入类工具成功后记录文件；agent 空闲且存在改动时启动只读工具白名单的子代理审查，并将结果写入会话消息。
dsh-auto-review 的功能「手动审查命令」：输入 /review 可在后台触发当前会话尚未审查的改动；没有改动、审查禁用或服务未就绪时会返回对应状态。
dsh-auto-review 的功能「Auto Mode 状态控制」：/security 显示当前模式和规则状态，/security auto on 或 off 切换会话状态；Web 客户端在输入框旁显示状态徽标。

dsh-auto-review README · dsh-auto-review：**DSH Auto Mode** — the native security-review plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH).

Pre-execution rule interception **+** delivery-time independent subagent deep review. Security first, trust second, quality third.

A native implementation of the Codex / Claude Code *auto mode* idea — built for **long-running agents**.

dsh-auto-review README · Why dsh-auto-review is a good choice for long-running agents：Long-running agents accumulate trust, context and write access over hours or days — and risk accumulates with them. dsh-auto-review adds a **persistent, always-on security layer** that never depends on the model remembering to be careful:
section: Why dsh-auto-review is a good choice for long-running agents

text:
dsh-auto-review README · Why dsh-auto-review is a good choice for long-running agents：- **Always on by default** — Auto Mode is session-scoped, enabled by default, and survives restarts (folded from official `command/run` events, replayable). `/security auto off` is the only way to disable it, and it only affects the current session.
- **Orthogonal to permissions** — granting `danger-full-access` or any other permission preset never disables content review. The permission system answers *"can the agent do this?"*; Auto Mode answers *"should it?"*. Both fail closed.
- **Two independent layers** — local rules intercept *before* execution (no LLM involved, cannot be argued with); a fresh read-only subagent reviews every delivery (no confirmation bias, no shared context).
- **Fail-closed by default** — interception defaults to **deny**; high-severity findings ask "fix / ignore" and default to **fix**; an interrupted or unparseable review is **never** reported as clean.
- **Zero-friction UX** — one-sentence risk summaries, a green "auto" badge on the composer (status only, not clickable), plain slash commands.

text: dsh-auto-review README · Layer 1 — pre-execution rule interception：`write` / `edit` / `str_replace_editor` / `bash` / `read` actions are checked against local rules (secrets, dangerous commands, sensitive paths). A match raises an approval question — allow once / deny, **default deny** (fail-closed). Only the root agent is intercepted.

dsh-auto-review README · Layer 2 — delivery-time deep review：When the root agent idles after making changes, a fresh read-only subagent (`read` / `grep` / `glob` only — no writes, no commands) reviews the changes:

- clean → reports so
- high-severity issues → asks **fix / ignore**, default **fix** (answer injected into the main agent)
- mid/low issues → reports only
- interrupted / unparseable → **never** reports clean

dsh-auto-review README · Auto Mode：- Session-scoped toggle, **default ON**, survives restarts.
- `/security` shows status; `/security auto on|off` toggles (off = current session only, reversible).
- Web: green **"auto"** badge at the left of the input box when active, dim when off — status only, not clickable.
- cc-tui: no slot mechanism — status via `/security` output and toggle command replies.

dsh-auto-review README · Install：Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness). The plugin is a single ESM package (Node 18+).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AtropinolTT/dsh-auto-review.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-auto-review
dsh plugin --profile cc-tui add /path/to/dsh-auto-review
```

For the web "auto" badge, add `"dsh-auto-review"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`, then restart `dsh web`.

dsh-auto-review README · Commands：- `/review` — trigger a review manually (background)
- `/security` — plugin status (Auto Mode, rules, review layer, high-severity threshold)
- `/security auto on|off` — toggle Auto Mode for this session

dsh-auto-review README · Behavior summary：| Trigger | Mechanism | Default |
|---|---|---|
| write/edit/bash/read hits a rule | approval question (allow once / deny) | **deny** |
| agent idle with changes | read-only subagent review | report; high → ask **fix** |
| review interrupted / unparseable | — | **never** reports clean |
dsh-auto-review README · 中文说明：dsh-auto-review 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的安全审查插件，实现 Codex / Claude Code "auto mode" 的原生版本，面向 **长时运行 agent**（长时间会话中信任、上下文与写权限不断累积，风险随之累积）：

dsh-auto-review README · 中文说明：- **两层审查**：执行前本地规则拦截（不经过 LLM、无法被说服，命中即弹「批准一次/拒绝」，默认拒绝，fail-closed）+ 交付时独立只读子代理深审（read/grep/glob，无写、无命令；干净才报干净，高危默认要求修复，中断绝不报 clean）。
- **Auto Mode**：会话级总开关，**默认开启**且跨重启保留（由官方 `command/run` 事件折叠）；与 permission 正交——即使 full access 也不豁免内容审查；`/security auto off` 仅停用当前会话。
- **呈现**：web 输入框左侧绿色 "auto" 徽标（仅状态，不可点击）；cc-tui 无 Slot 机制，以 `/security` 输出为准。
- **原则**：安全第一、信任第二、质量第三；安全、精简、快速、高效。
- 项目前名 security-review（git 历史中可见），正式名 dsh-auto-review。
- 命令：`/review` 手动触发审查；`/security`、`/security auto on|off` 查看/切换状态。
